name: FCC 324 (Hubble)
blurb: FCC 324, an early-type galaxy in the Fornax Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: fcc324-hubble
story: An early-type galaxy among the members of the Fornax Cluster, one of the galaxies Hubble surveyed to study the cluster's early-type population and their compact cores.

claims.text: FCC 324 is an early-type galaxy in the ACS Fornax Cluster Survey sample, also cataloged as E358-G66
The ACS Fornax Cluster Survey targets early-type Fornax Cluster galaxies
